title: The Queen of Heaven
aka: cakes for the Queen of Heaven
lead: A goddess to whom the women of Judah baked cakes and poured out drink offerings in the last years before 586 BC (Jeremiah 7:18; 44:17-19, 25). Scholars usually identify her with Ishtar or Astarte, the West Semitic and Mesopotamian goddess of love, war and the planet Venus. Centuries later Christians began to call Mary 'Queen of Heaven' in a different sense.
